eyebrow: GET: reading data with query params
code:
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.shipfast-carrier.com/v2/shipments",
    params={"order_id": "NB-10492", "status": "in_transit"},
    timeout=10,
)
response.raise_for_status()

shipment = response.json()
print(shipment["tracking_number"], shipment["eta"])
caption: params builds the query string -- GET never changes anything on the server.

eyebrow: POST: writing data with a JSON body
code:
payload = {
    "order_id": "NB-10492",
    "carrier_service": "ground",
    "weight_kg": 2.3,
}

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.shipfast-carrier.com/v2/shipments",
    json=payload,
    timeout=10,
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json()["shipment_id"])
caption: json= serializes the dict and sets Content-Type for you.
